title: Foundry Ring
pages: Craft the controller from sealed steel plates, furnaces and one Screened Silica from the Rotary Screen. Build a three-course foundry: a source lava hearth directly beneath the controller, four stone-brick sides and four iron-block corners below; three furnaces against the north, east and west faces, with the fourth furnace two blocks south so the controller's south face stays open; brick corners on its course. Above, place four iron-bar vents, two copper heat sinks at the north corners and two empty cauldrons as slag cups at the south corners. The top center stays open. North is fixed, so turn the whole arrangement to match the projector, not the controller (25 parts).

Right-click the controller with eight batches of a recipe's input. All eight batches load into the controller together; after 40 ticks, right-click with an empty hand to collect the eight results. A busy controller refuses another heat without consuming it. Most recipes take one item per batch; the polished-stone, deepslate-brick and raw-metal recipes take four items for five results, so a heat uses 32 and returns 40. Silk-touched ores yield more than a furnace: diamond and nether quartz ore give 2, redstone ore 5 and lapis ore 6 each. Cobblestone, clay and the stone, nether and blackstone brick recipes stay one-for-one because crushing, polishing or brick reclaiming can reverse them. Breaking a furnace, hearth lining, hood vent, copper heat sink or empty slag cup, or removing the source lava, stops production. Restore the missing part to resume.

Its 21 exclusive foundry recipes cover three families: stone heating (tuff, andesite, blackstone, diorite, granite, prismarine, stone bricks, deepslate bricks, nether bricks, polished blackstone bricks, cobblestone to stone, clay ball to brick) and crude ore smelting (raw iron, raw gold, raw copper, diamond ore, lapis ore, redstone ore, nether gold ore, nether quartz ore). Fire eight brick blocks into eight Fired Foundry Liners; one liner is required for the Leaching Vat craft and another for the Electrolyzer craft, so the ring is a required t2 device. These recipes are separate from vanilla minecraft:smelting; a plain furnace will not process them and the ring will not accept other mods' furnace recipes. JEI lists all 21 under the Foundry Ring catalyst, showing the eightfold batch input and eight separate outputs. For automation, feed the open top from a hopper or pipe; the ring waits for eight matching batches, then runs them together. Sneak-right-click the exposed south controller face with an empty hand once to set it to output, and extract there with a pipe. Other faces may be set to input, output or disabled the same way. Stock pauses while the frame is broken and remains buffered across saves. The ring needs its lava hearth but no FE.
